detail.longDescription:
SuperCode is an offline mobile IDE, code editor, and fast text editor for Android developers, engineers, and CS students. Write, format, compile, debug, and deploy multi-file projects in Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript, SQL, PHP, HTML/CSS, Lua, and Shell right on your phone or tablet—no internet needed for local builds.

■ Offline Compilers & Split-Screen Console
Run multi-file workspaces in an interactive split terminal with ANSI colors, live stdin, and timing:

• Python Compiler & Offline Python IDE (3.11 / 3.12) + PIP: Run multi-file Python locally with live input(). Install packages from PyPI, requirements.txt, or offline .whl/.tar.gz/.zip files. On-device scientific runtime supports 65+ data libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, Pillow), saving charts to your project.

• Offline C Compiler, C++ Compiler & C++ IDE: C17 and C++20 standards with full STL, multi-file .h/.hpp header resolution, CMakeLists.txt/Makefile awareness, and live cin/scanf input for systems and algorithms.

• Offline Java Compiler & Java 17 IDE: Build multi-file Java packages locally with modern syntax (record, sealed, switch, text blocks, Streams), interactive Scanner, and built-in SQLite JDBC.

• Offline SQL Editor & SQLite Inspector: Native SQLite 3.54 (MySQL/PostgreSQL) engine for .sql scripts and direct .db/.sqlite inspection, CTEs, window functions, FTS5, 9 output formats (box grid, Markdown, CSV, JSON), CSV/JSON import/export, plus optional cloud MySQL 8.0.

• HTML Editor, Local Web Server, Offline PHP & DevTools: Local HTTP server for HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, WebAssembly, and offline PHP with PDO SQLite, sessions, and forms. Preview Mobile/Tablet/Desktop viewports, live Console Logs, and an interactive JS REPL.

• JavaScript / Node.js, Lua 5.4, Bash Shell & Cloud: Run ES2024 JavaScript (27 Node core modules), native Lua 5.4, and sandboxed Linux Shell locally, with optional cloud execution for Kotlin, PHP CLI, and heavy ML frameworks.

■ Smart Code Editor & 29 Customizable Tools
• Syntax highlighting for 70+ formats: Python, C/C++, Java, Kotlin, JS/TS, HTML/Vue/Svelte, CSS/SCSS, SQL, PHP, Lua, Go, Rust, Swift, C#, Dart, Ruby, YAML, TOML, JSON, XML, Dockerfile, Makefile.
• Context-aware coding assist: Smart code completion, real-time linting with Error Radar, one-tap Code Formatter, smart Toggle Comment, and bracket auto-close.
• 21-Key Swipe Symbol Keyboard: 6 language profiles (40+ symbols), 29-tool bar, 5-slot Quick Menu, Regex Find & Replace, statistics, Selection Translate, PDF export, 59 runnable Code Examples, and an Offline Project Scaffolder.

■ Local File Manager, Global File Tree & GB File Editor
• Full Local Storage & SAF File Explorer: Manage multi-file project trees across internal storage, SD/USB OTG, and SAF—create, rename, copy, move, delete, and search directories.
• Seamless paging for 30 MB+ files: Open GB logs smoothly with Global Stream Regex Replace and a 100K+ line Virtual Clipboard.
• 34 Encodings & Built-in Viewers: Auto-detect UTF-8, UTF-16, GBK, Big5, Shift_JIS, EUC-KR, ISO-8859, and Windows-125x with lossless save checks, plus native PDF Viewer and Image Gallery (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, HEIC, AVIF, SVG).

■ Visual Git Client, Encrypted SFTP/FTPS & 8 Themes
• Visual Git & Time Machine: HTTPS Clone (PAT), Branching, Commit & Push, Pull, unified diff history, and side-by-side Merge Conflict Resolver.
• Remote Servers: SFTP, FTPS (TLS), and FTP with AES-256 credentials, SSH private keys, host fingerprint checks, live editing, and batch transfers.
• 8 Themes + 32 UI Languages (LTR & RTL): VS Code Dark/Light, Carbon Obsidian AMOLED, Nordic Frost, Tokyo Midnight, Darcula, Monokai, Solarized, Auto Day/Night, Zen Mode, Hot Exit recovery, and Storage Slimming.

A complete offline coding app and mobile programming workstation ready wherever you build.
